title: 检查过的碗
title_en: The bowls that had been checked

lines.text: 公司在景德镇的一家工厂订了五千个白瓷碗，杰克去工厂验货。

lines.en: The company has ordered five thousand white porcelain bowls from a factory in Jingdezhen, and Jack goes to the factory to inspect them.
